# AGM | The Cool Consultant

> AGM | The Cool Consultant is an HVAC contractor based in Doha, Qatar with more than 10 years of experience. AGM designs, installs, commissions and maintains air conditioning and HVAC systems for commercial, residential and industrial clients across Qatar. Unlike consultant-only firms, AGM combines engineering design knowledge with full contractor execution.

## Key facts
- Business type: HVAC Contractor (design + installation + maintenance)
- Location: Al Riffa Tower, Building No. 04, Street 821, Zone 18, Old Salata, Doha, Qatar
- Service area: Doha and the wider State of Qatar
- Experience: 10+ years
- Phone: +974 7707 1657
- Email: info@agmqatar.com, siraj@agmqatar.com
- Positioning: "The Cool Consultant" — consultant knowledge with contractor execution

## Services
- [HVAC & AC Installation](https://www.agmqatar.com/services): split, package, ducted and central air conditioning
- [VRF Systems](https://www.agmqatar.com/services/vrf-systems): energy-efficient Variable Refrigerant Flow systems
- [Chilled Water Systems](https://www.agmqatar.com/services): central chiller plants for high-capacity cooling
- [DX & Package Units](https://www.agmqatar.com/services): direct expansion and packaged cooling
- [HVAC Design Support](https://www.agmqatar.com/services): load calculations, equipment selection, drawings
- [Maintenance & AMC](https://www.agmqatar.com/services): preventive and corrective annual maintenance contracts

## Industries served
- Commercial (offices, malls, hotels, retail)
- Residential (villas, apartments, compounds)
- Industrial (factories, warehouses, plants)
